main_text.p: rinde obligatur, ac quivis paterfamilias. IIII. Quod de filio dictũ est, id in filia quoq;locũ habet. Hastenus quã Grã-maticam & quam item Dialecticam tractandi Iuris rationem appellaremus, abunde explicatũ esse arbitramur. Reliquũ est igitur, ut quam Iurisconsultorum propria esse putemus, breviter aperiamus. Hæc aut non tã in Iuris-consultorum scriptis, quàm in ipsis causis atque controversijs explicandis tota consumitur. Quare quo facilius intelligi perspicique posit, quot quæque controversiarum omnium summa genera
[The line break after "Iurif-" is uncertain; the word may be "Iuris-consultorum" as shown.]

page.notes: Faint handwritten marks in the right margin beside "quam" and below it are manuscript annotations, not printed text, and are left out. The word "posit" in "perspicique posit," appears as printed and may be an error for "possit". The hyphenation at "Iurif-" is hard to read and is uncertain. The running head reads "IVRISCONSVLTIS." with some uncertain letters in the scan. The signature "f 5" and catchword "ra" were read at the foot of the text column. The text on this page is one paragraph, since no line is indented.
